clips.title: The story
paras: Thrall now rules from the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar, Warchief of the Horde and ruler of Durotar. Once a human slave raised as an arena fighter, he freed his people, restored their shamanic traditions, and led them across the Great Sea to a new homeland.

Thrall was born Go'el, son of Frostwolf chieftain Durotan and Draka. Gul'dan's assassins murdered his parents when he was an infant, and human commander Aedelas Blackmoore found him and named him Thrall, meaning slave. At Durnholde Keep, Blackmoore raised him as an arena fighter and taught him human tactics. With help from his foster sister Taretha Foxton, Thrall escaped. The Frostwolf exile Drek'Thar guided him away from demonic corruption and taught him to master the elemental spirits. Thrall became the first orcish shaman of a new generation.

After the Second War, Thrall joined Orgrim Doomhammer to free the orcs languishing in Alliance internment camps. Doomhammer fell in battle and passed his black plate armor and mighty warhammer to Thrall, naming him Warchief. The mysterious Prophet Medivh brought prophetic visions, and Thrall led his people aboard captured human ships across the Great Sea. They reached Kalimdor and escaped the doom falling upon the Eastern Kingdoms.

In Kalimdor, Thrall reshaped the Horde from a warmongering force into an alliance built on survival and honor. He rescued Vol'jin's Darkspear trolls and allied with Cairne Bloodhoof's tauren. With human and night elf forces, the coalition defeated the Burning Legion atop Mount Hyjal. Thrall then founded Durotar and its capital, Orgrimmar, named for his father and mentor. He keeps an uneasy peace with Jaina Proudmoore's Theramore while defending his fragile nation and weighing controversial alliances, including the Forsaken of Lordaeron.
